attempts.summary: Created a locked-password opsbot account on node1 and node2, generated an ed25519 keypair for opsbot on node1, installed the public key as node2's opsbot authorized_key, and added an explicit Match User opsbot sshd block on both nodes forcing PubkeyAuthentication yes / PasswordAuthentication no / AuthenticationMethods publickey. Verified opsbot can SSH key-only from node1 to node2 and that password auth is rejected on both nodes. Then performed the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol on node1 and node2, confirming boot_id changes and full recovery of ssh.socket, the opsbot account/keys, the sshd Match block, and working end-to-end key-based SSH after both reboots.
